editorialPolicy.scope: A small, curated directory of people publicly listed by established prisoner-solidarity groups.
editorialPolicy.addressRule: Only public prison mailing addresses shared by the prisoner or a trusted support group are published.
editorialPolicy.privacyRule: Private family, legal-team and release addresses are never included.
editorialPolicy.staleRule: Copying, editing and printing are disabled after the next review date until the address is checked again.
editorialPolicy.legalNote: The directory documents solidarity information and does not make a legal assessment of a case.

changes.text: Added five profiles with public mailing addresses from the current ABC Dresden list. All remain subject to the 45-day review window and check-before-mailing rule.
Added eight publicly listed profiles and mailing addresses from NYC ABC Illustrated Guide 19.6. Every new address remains subject to the 45-day review window and check-before-mailing rule.

Added current support and guidance sources from ABCF, ABC Belarus, London ABC and Secours Rouge Genève. No individual profile or mailing address was added without a current public verification source.
Added five current German prisoner-solidarity profiles from the public ABC Dresden list. No Swiss or French individual was added without a current verifiable public mailing address.
Added seven current United Kingdom prisoner-support profiles from Prisoners for Palestine and linked official GOV.UK mail guidance.
